hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I caught the new maid, Betty, wandering alone in the dim, shadowy corridors of our London manor. The candles flickered, casting an eerie light upon her, and I saw the fear in her eyes. I couldn't help but wonder, would I have helped her lace her corset or left her to her fate? #18thCentury #PeriodDrama #HistoricalRomance
caption:
, caught in the shadows of our attic.
